title: Shrimp Skillet with Feta
description: A quick and delicious Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring succulent shrimp, crispy vegetables, and tangy feta cheese.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced red onion and cook for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the diced tomato and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Return the cooked shrimp to the skillet and stir in the crumbled feta cheese.
Season with salt, black pepper, and lemon juice to taste.
Serve the shrimp and vegetable mixture hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
